title: Tighten the task-sync data-branch rule wording in both projects (define MAIN, merge and push kind, export-only, never another remote) and fix stale approval summaries
outcome: The data-branch rule in TermAl and Engram states its limits precisely and identically, and command/skill/doc summaries of commit authority match the instruction files.
acceptance: In both projects the task-sync data-branch bullet defines the data worktree location without the undefined 'MAIN', names the allowed merge kind and that the push is a fast-forward of origin's engram-data, limits commits to export files, and says never another remote; the two projects' bullets stay identical.

TermAl review-changes.md 'never pushed' names the author-test-ref exception, and pre-existing approval-only summaries in skills/docs name the same exceptions as CLAUDE.md; list formatting and line length are tidied.
Lands under the authority-file rule (both coordinators, Greg notice, final-diff audit) as a clarification; no test reads the instruction files.
